openapi.description: Generated live from the running server - it can't go stale.
openapi.selectRoleDescription: The Data API document only lists what a principal may do - pick a role to see exactly what its API consumers get.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Every route your API consumers can call, live and read-only.
endpoints.emptyDescription: Expose a resource or publish a workflow with an HTTP trigger to see its routes here.

editImage.title: Edit image
editImage.description: Resize, crop, and convert - originals are never modified until you choose to save.
editImage.saveAsHelp: Saves the edited image as a new file. The original is untouched.
editImage.saveAndReplaceHelp: Overwrites the original file's content with this edited version. This cannot be undone.
editImage.replaceImageHelp: Replaces this file's content with {name}. Any edits made above are discarded. This cannot be undone.

page.folderExists: A folder with that name already exists here
page.failedRetry: {n} failed - selection kept so you can retry.
page.madePublic: {n} files made public | {n} file made public | {n} files made public
page.madePrivate: {n} files made private | {n} file made private | {n} files made private
page.filesUpdated: {n} files updated | {n} file updated | {n} files updated
page.title: Files
page.noMatchDescription: Try a different name, description, or tag.
page.emptyDescription: Files uploaded here will appear in this list.
page.renameHelp: Up to 255 characters. The extension follows the name.
page.descriptionHelp: Optional note shown with this file.
page.tagsHelp: Labels used to organize this file.
page.tagsEnter: Type a tag and press Enter.
page.deleteHelp: This permanently deletes the selected files and their metadata. This cannot be undone.

page.title: Audit Logs
page.description: {range} · every write and access event made through TotalBase. Read-only.
page.emptyFiltered: No entries in {range} matching these filters

panel.customRangeHint: Whole days, in your local time zone.

variables.userName: The recipient's name - their email when they have none.
variables.actionUrl: The single-use link the person follows. Required.
variables.expiresIn: How long the link stays valid, e.g. "7 days".
variables.newEmail: Email changed only - the address it changed to (the email goes to the previous one, user.email).

editor.sendingTooltip: This email is sent. Click to stop sending it.
editor.offTooltip: This email is not sent. Click to send it.
editor.bodyHelp: Send an HTML body, a plain-text body, or both - mail apps show the plain text when they can't show HTML.
editor.layoutHelp: The HTML body is sent inside TotalBase's email layout (font, width and an instance footer) - use Preview to see it.
editor.actionRequired: Each body you fill in must include {placeholder}.
editor.variablesHelp: Click to copy. Only these are allowed - anything else is rejected on save.
editor.linkSetting: Where the link points is set in Settings → Auth → Email links.
editor.previewDescription: Rendered for you with a sample link - includes unsaved changes. Nothing is sent.
editor.restoreDescription: Your edits to this email are discarded and TotalBase's built-in version is used again.
editor.leaveDescription: This email has changes that haven't been saved.

user_invitation.label: Invitation
user_invitation.description: Sent when an admin invites someone - the link lets them set their password.

password_reset.label: Password reset
password_reset.description: Sent when someone asks to reset a forgotten password, or an admin sends a reset.

email_verification.label: Email verification
email_verification.description: Sent after registration so the person confirms they own the address.

password_changed.label: Password changed
password_changed.description: A security notice sent after a password is changed or reset.

email_changed.label: Email changed
email_changed.description: A security notice sent to the previous address when an admin changes a user's email.

user_welcome.label: Welcome
user_welcome.description: Sent once an invited or registered account is ready to use (off by default).

MAILING.label: Email
MAILING.description: Subject and message with {example} placeholders, sent by a workflow's Send email step.

PDF.label: PDF
PDF.description: A pdfme design rendered into a generated document.

newModal.description: Pick its type and name it - the content comes next.

landing.title: Select a template

pdfDesigner.loadError: Could not load the PDF designer
pdfDesigner.fixedPdf: This template's page is a fixed PDF file, not a plain page size - width/height aren't editable here.
pdfDesigner.largerScreen: Placing and editing fields needs a larger screen.
